newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania leu firms, seen stabilising.
newsitem.headline: Romania leu firms, seen stabilising.

text.p: Romania's leu closed firmer on Monday, with banks' screens quoting spreads from 6,200/6,300 to 6,800/6,900 to the dollar, from its opening level of 7,000/7,300, on a dormant interbank market.
Operators said they expected the leu to hover at or dip slightly below the 7,000 level against the greenback and to stabilise there for a while.
The money market was fairly liquid with short-term rates around 220 percent, amid traders' expectations of a gradual easing of the rates on a market marked by "leu hunger".
Leu-dollar retail rates bobbed around 6,750/7,200. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
